user_query: I'm a music enthusiast and I want to discover new songs and artists. Can you recommend some popular songs and artists from different genres using the 'charts/list' API? Additionally, fetch the basic user info and top tracks of a Soundcloud user with the profile URL 'https://soundcloud.com/user-977421934' to explore their music taste.

TaskList.description: Fetch popular songs and artists from different genres using the charts/list API.
Fetch basic user information of the Soundcloud user from the provided profile URL.
Fetch top tracks of the Soundcloud user based on the user info retrieved in the previous step.
